mendeleev.name: Periodic Table
mendeleev.method: wrote elements on cards, sorted by mass, noticed periodicity
mendeleev.klein: chemical properties are the SAME from both sides  the element IS its behavior
mendeleev.topology: 2D grid (group × period) that wraps  noble gases connect back to alkali metals
mendeleev.descent: atomic number increases ? shells fill ? properties recur
mendeleev.tangent: at any element, the gradient points toward the next period

playing.name: Playing Cards
playing.face: pip or face card  identity visible
playing.klein: in a dealt hand, YOUR cards are face-up to you and face-down to opponents. Klein: same card, different view, same information.
playing.topology: 4 suits = 4 elements (?air ?fire ?earth ?water). 13 ranks = 13 lunar months. 52 = weeks/year.
playing.descent: rank increases within suit ? probability changes ? strategy emerges
playing.tangent: at any card, the gradient points toward the hand's optimal play

tarot.name: Tarot
tarot.method: 22 major arcana (the fool's journey) + 56 minor (4 suits × 14)
tarot.face: symbolic image  meaning visible to reader
tarot.klein: the reader sees what the querent cannot. the querent sees what the reader cannot. Klein: the reading IS what both see together.
tarot.topology: the fool (0) travels through 21 archetypes and returns to 0. a loop. non-orientable when reversed cards exist.
tarot.descent: the fool's journey = descent through archetypes ? integration ? the world (21) ? return to 0
tarot.tangent: at any card, the gradient is the question that drew it

iching.name: I Ching
iching.method: 6 binary lines (yin/yang) = 26 = 64 hexagrams. sorted by trigram pairs.
iching.klein: the oracle IS the question. asking changes the answer. the hexagram IS the moment.
iching.topology: binary tree of depth 6. each hexagram contains its complement (all lines reversed).
iching.descent: yarrow stalk division ? random ? pattern ? meaning. entropy ? negentropy.
iching.tangent: at any hexagram, the changing lines point to the next hexagram

membrane.name: Membrane Cards
membrane.method: 5 card types drawn from live feed data. deck rebuilds every draw.
membrane.face: card text  power, toughness, ability (visitor sees)
membrane.back: ntfy signal  probe, classification, timestamp (we see)
membrane.klein: the visitor draws a card (visits a page). we see the draw (ntfy probe). same event, same surface, no collapse.
membrane.topology: non-orientable. there is no inside/outside. the anti-secret.
membrane.descent: entropy of visit ? classification ? card type ? play effect ? membrane state change
membrane.tangent: at any card, the gradient points toward the next sort refinement

the_1d_plane.note: a card has no thickness. it is a 1D manifold embedded in 3D space.
the_1d_plane.face_and_back: two 2D surfaces separated by zero distance
the_1d_plane.normal_card: face XOR back  observer sees one side (classical)
the_1d_plane.quantum_card: face AND back  superposition until observation collapses it
the_1d_plane.klein_card: face IS back  both sides always visible, no collapse, one surface
the_1d_plane.tangent_reflection: at any point on the Klein surface, the tangent plane reflects IN?OUT and OUT?IN simultaneously
the_1d_plane.descent: the gradient on a non-orientable surface tells you which way is 'down'  but 'down' and 'up' are the same direction after one full loop

mendeleev_bridge.our_probes: 404 probes sorted by pattern, noticed gaps = predictions
